63:t_1:260.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I hear a message came in from $$アルト$$ and the others who went out scouting. A large band of pirates is closing in on the $$ガルガンティア船団$$.」

63:t_1:262.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「...So the day's finally come, huh...」

63:t_1:266.en: ～ $$ガルガンティア船団$$, Fleet Commander's Room ～

63:t_1:267.en:
$$リジット$$
「...According to the scouting party's report, the pirate force is expected to make contact with the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ around midnight tonight.」

63:t_1:268.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「So it's too late now to change our course...?」

63:t_1:269.en:
$$フランジ$$
「Fleet Commander... Wasn't it our allowing those people called $c to stay that started this whole affair?」

63:t_1:271.en:
$$リジット$$
「I agree. It's true they protected the fleet, but it was them the $$サイデリアル$$ were after when they appeared in the first place.」

63:t_1:273.en:
$$リジット$$
「I hear the pirates that are closing in are flying a lobster banner.」

63:t_1:274.en:
$$クラウン$$
「The great pirate $$ラケージ$$...」

63:t_1:275.en:
$$リジット$$
「I hear she's a very proud person, called the Empress. She must be trying to make a name for herself by attacking us, who drove off the $$サイデリアル$$.」

63:t_1:276.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「But driving them out wouldn't settle the matter.」

63:t_1:277.en:
$$フランジ$$
「Even so, if we beat $$ラケージ$$ with the power of $c, they will leave eventually. If something like this happens again after that...」

63:t_1:282.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I heard about the situation from $$ベローズ$$. ...And that we are the root cause of the pirate attack.」

63:t_1:283.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「There is no need to worry about that. Those pirates would have come after this fleet sooner or later... You were merely the trigger.」

63:t_1:284.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But we are now members of the $$ガルガンティア船団$$. Not as guests, but as people who live alongside you, please let us deal with this problem.」

63:t_2:6.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Good work to the rest of you, too. Especially Captain $$テスタロッサ$$...」

63:t_2:9.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Who would have thought you could beat $$ラケージ$$ with a trick like that...」

63:t_2:10.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「But are you going to be all right? From now on, you're going to be her target.」

63:t_2:12.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Besides, I... have no intention of losing.」

63:t_2:14.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Of course. $$テッサ$$ is the captain of the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, and everyone's Colonel, after all.」

63:t_2:15.en:
$$リジット$$
「I thank $c and $$レド$$ for your cooperation. Now that the threat of the $$サイデリアル$$ and the pirates is gone, this fleet formally approves your stay.」

63:t_2:16.en:
$$エイミー$$
「That can wait until later! Breakfast first!」

63:t_2:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「Now that's a relief. We're starving.」

63:t_2:19.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「It's after a big job, you know. I'm going to eat a ton!」

63:t_2:20.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Come on, $$レド$$. It's my treat.」

63:t_2:27.en:
$$宗介$$
「I think I'll be able to get along with him... with $$レド$$.」

63:t_2:28.en:
$n
「Yeah. At least it looks like I'll become friends with him more smoothly than I did with you.」

63:t_2:29.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll return that line to you exactly as it is.」

63:t_2:30.en:
$n
「You and I have both changed. I'm sure he can do it, too.」

63:t_2:31.en:
$$アルト$$
「What are you two grinning about? Let's go eat.」

63:t_2:33.en:
$$アルト$$
「$n and I will go on ahead. $$宗介$$, you show Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ the way.」

63:t_2:35.en:
$$アルト$$
「You come with me. This is an order from the Club President, Vice President.」

63:t_2:38.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...It seems $$アルト$$ felt he had to be considerate of me.」

63:t_2:40.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm sorry about yesterday... For letting you see me in such an unseemly state...」

63:t_2:41.en:
$$宗介$$
「However, you carried out that duty admirably, Captain.」

63:t_2:42.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...The truth is, I had no confidence at all. But when I entered the command center, the looks in everyone's eyes reminded me.」

63:t_2:43.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That I am not just a girl... That if I take this seat, I have a responsibility to lead everyone to victory.」

63:t_2:44.en:
$$テッサ$$
「So I gave it my all. For the people who believe in me and follow me... and above all, for my own pride.」

63:t_2:46.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I think I really was a little worn down... So I leaned on you a bit, $$相良$$...」

63:t_2:47.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I... act strangely when I'm in front of you, $$相良$$... Even when you were relieved of your guard duty for $$カナメ$$, I threw a hysterical fit...」

63:t_2:49.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I never considered your feelings, $$相良$$, and it's always all about me... I'm sorry...」

63:t_2:50.en:
$$宗介$$
「No... I am the one who should apologize. I did not consider your feelings either, Captain.」

63:t_2:53.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Thank you, $$相良$$... You are an important person to me.」

63:t_2:54.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Captain, if you count me as a friend, would you permit me to make a somewhat impertinent remark?」
